findings.description: All 14 high->evolving entries carry requires_user_confirm=true and summary.requires_user_confirm=14. Policy: high->evolving is applied automatically; user confirmation is only for stable promotion or deprecation/demotion. No entry in this plan is a stable promotion or a demotion, so requires_user_confirm must be false everywhere (summary 0). apply_with ('after user approval') also contradicts the policy for these transitions.
findings.suggested_action: Set requires_user_confirm=false on every draft->evolving entry, set summary.requires_user_confirm=0, and change apply_with to automatic application of draft->evolving.

findings.description: The medium label (79, product_fit 6/10, the lowest product_fit in the target) rests on the condition that the CLAUDE.md edit needs user authorization. That is a mistaken assumption: the user explicitly asked for CLAUDE.md to be edited, and D-448 (design.md:60) requires wave 1 to update its module line. Only the remaining deductions are backed by facts: the (미확정) markers that are not about module names (docs/api/app.md:22, docs/api/logging.md:33), and the dependency on the final logger names from CON-BUILD-002. Removing the unbacked deduction moves product_fit to about 9-10 and the total to 82-83, which is high, so the plan should be draft->evolving.
findings.suggested_action: Drop the CLAUDE.md authorization condition, re-score product_fit (expected 9-10) and the total, relabel high, and change the plan entry to draft->evolving (requires_user_confirm=false).

findings.description: Two of the reasons that lower this to medium are not backed by fact. (1) 'Adding a build-script dependency must not violate CON-BUILD-006': CON-BUILD-006 governs the module api/implementation/runtimeOnly/compileOnly configurations, not the buildscript or plugin classpath. A buildscript ASM dependency, jdeps from JDK 17 or a constant-pool scan in Groovy are all allowed, and TinyHttpd build.gradle:51-61 already shows the pattern for resolving a classpath check. (2) The scope_fit deduction because the items are 'from loop-W integration items, not a numbered D- item' contradicts design.md:5, which puts the build-related I-items in scope at this wave's merge. With those reasons removed, the score (77) plausibly crosses the high threshold (80).
findings.suggested_action: Remove both reasons, re-score implementability and scope_fit from the real remaining effort (three custom checks plus negative fixtures), and relabel if the total reaches 80 or more.

findings.description: synthesis.verdict_reason and key_conditions repeat 'CLAUDE.md edits (OPS-BUILD-003) need explicit user authorization' and the mutation-plan reason for OPS-BUILD-003 cites it, although the condition is void (see the OPS-BUILD-003 finding). The distribution (14/2), stability_drift_candidates and the plan summary must change with any relabel.
findings.suggested_action: Remove the CLAUDE.md authorization condition from synthesis and the mutation plan, then recompute the distribution, average, drift candidates and plan summary after re-scoring.

findings.description: CON-BUILD-011 traces to CON-BUILD-006 (existing_srs_context edge 011->006), while CON-BUILD-006 AC-2/AC-4/AC-6 need the library that CON-BUILD-011 chooses, and the judgement condition says 'depends on the nullability library choice of CON-BUILD-011 being made first'. That is a semantic two-way dependency. synthesis.dependency_cycles=[] and the chains list only 011->006, so the ordering is not recorded.
findings.suggested_action: Record that CON-BUILD-006 and CON-BUILD-011 are co-implemented, or that the library choice comes first, in synthesis.dependency_chains or the conditions, so that the SDS and work order put the CON-BUILD-011 decision first.

findings.description: The OPS-BUILD-002 conditions say it depends on CON-BUILD-004 AC-3, and AC-5 references CON-BUILD-007 AC-2, but the synthesis dependency_chains show only OPS-BUILD-002 -> CON-BUILD-003 -> CON-BUILD-002.
findings.suggested_action: Add the OPS-BUILD-002 -> CON-BUILD-004 and OPS-BUILD-002 -> CON-BUILD-007 edges to dependency_chains. No cycle results.
